chunks: And in the narration of ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from him, peace be upon him, that he said:

“There is no harm in a man performing the voluntary tawaf without wudu (ablution), then performing wudu and praying. And if he performed tawaf intentionally without wudu, then he should perform wudu and pray.”

key_terms.النَّافِلَةَ: a voluntary, non-obligatory act of tawaf

ai.seo_question: Is wudu required for voluntary tawaf and its prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning voluntary tawaf performed without wudu (ablution). It states that such tawaf does not pose a problem, but the person must perform wudu before offering the prayer connected to tawaf; if he did so intentionally without wudu, he should still perform wudu and then pray.
